api.read_semantics: reads the last PostgreSQL-persisted collection; source collection runs only in the background loop

invariants: missing or unavailable measurements are unknown and never contribute to a passing quality score
formal Kafka lag comes from broker end offsets minus committed consumer-group offsets, never a ClickHouse insertion-rate proxy
dataset, baseline, minimum audit and outbox state commit atomically in PostgreSQL
quality rules and repairs are tenant-scoped, versioned and default to observe or dry-run until independently approved
flow replay uses a dedicated readiness-validated projection topic and must never feed flow.events.v1 or duplicate the flows_raw authority
repair success cannot close an issue until authoritative facts, projections, object manifests and watermarks reconcile
domain.compensation: stop replay, preserve immutable evidence, reconcile in-flight identities, and execute an approved compensating repair without deleting authoritative facts

data.migration: expand with 202608041400 data-quality control plane, 202608041500 governance, 202608041600 rule evaluation and 202608041700 repair lifecycle migrations; shadow rules and real watermarks before any approved activation

negative_tests: cross-tenant dataset, rule, baseline, event, repair and sample references are rejected
write operations require data-quality:write and cannot accept tenant identity from request payload
repair requester cannot approve the same repair
unknown measurements remain partial or gray rather than pass or green

journeys: quality snapshot by tenant and dataset
stop_conditions: cross-tenant result, watermark regression, missing manifest, unreconciled replay expansion, online P99 or storage resource budget exceeds the approved baseline

tests: G0 Feature Contract, OpenAPI, migration and generated-client compatibility
G1 baseline transaction commit plus outbox and audit rollback injection
G2 real PostgreSQL, Kafka, Flink, ClickHouse and MinIO signal collection
G3 tenant-scoped repair replay and cross-store reconciliation
G4 fixed-scale quality evaluation and repair resource budgets
G5 Windows Chrome mock-off unknown, partial and lifecycle states
G6 expand, shadow, canary, rollback and in-flight repair handling
evidence: immutable candidate manifest, rule and baseline versions, source watermarks, repair identities, audit/outbox rows, object manifests, reconcile report, HAR, trace, rollback and T+0/T+1/T+3/T+7 observations
